out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not finished to have a smooth, cleanable surface: Trash cans observed for storage of raw whole chicken in walk in cooler. Container for raw chicken skewering observed with duct tape on the interior.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be finished to have a smooth, easily cleanable surface. EHS recommended food grade containers for raw chicken. PIC will replace container with duct tape.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed CUTTING BOARD located at the CHICKEN WARMER that is not being cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. -EHS recommends obtaining a second cutting board to rotate to have one to use while other board is being washed, rinsed, and sanitized.

violations.title: Food Contact Surface, 4 Hour Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed CUTTING BOARD located at the CHICKEN WARMER that is not being cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils must be cleaned and sanitized at least every 4 hours to prevent contamination by bacterial growth. -EHS recommends obtaining a second cutting board to rotate to have one to use while other board is being washed, rinsed, and sanitized.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: -sliced tomato (49F), shredded lettuce (47F), and white sauce (50F) observed in 1 Dr prep unit. Unit observed holding at 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. -Items observed holding in proper temperature in walk in cooler, items in prep unit rotated from walk in cooler. EHS has employee adjust temperature on unit to monitor. Items moved from walk in cooler may only be held in 1 Dr prep unit for a maximum of 4 hours.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Manufacturer containers for white vinegar were observed reused for the storage of green and white sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: Wooden spoon used for mixing sauces observed with deleterious edges.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. -Discussed with PIC to obtain new spoon without corrosion.

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 1 Dr prep unit.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. -TCS items in prep unit to be discarded.
